visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, slightly messy hair, wearing a denim jacket over a white t-shirt and white trousers, stands on a rocky beach. He looks directly at the camera, singing with expressive facial movements and open-handed gestures. The background features a calm sea under a bright, partly cloudy sky. (2) The camera transitions to a high-altitude aerial drone shot, revealing a vast, rugged coastline where the blue sea meets brown, rocky formations. Sparse green vegetation covers the land on the right side of the frame, showing a natural, wild landscape. (3) Back to the beach, the man in the denim jacket continues to sing, pointing his finger towards the camera and then to his side, his expressions conveyed with high energy and a slight smile. (4) The scene shifts to a road where the man is wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and a black helmet, riding a scooter. He lifts his left hand to wave at a truck driver in a blue vehicle moving in the same direction, showing a friendly interaction. (5) The man is seen on a city sidewalk next to a 7-Eleven store, still in his white shirt and helmet. He high-fives a man wearing a black t-shirt and glasses, both smiling warmly in a casual urban setting. (6) A drone shot shows the man standing atop a large pile of grey concrete tetrapods along the coast, spreading his arms wide against the backdrop of the deep blue ocean. (7) The man rides his motorcycle along a winding coastal highway, smiling broadly at the camera attached to his bike, with the lush green hillside on one side and the road ahead. (8) The final scene is underwater. The man, equipped with a diving mask and fins, swims alongside a large sea turtle. He holds a selfie stick, documenting the interaction in the clear blue water with bright sunlight filtering from above.
